paragraphs: Rabbi Yose bar Yasin: Avodah Zarah 42a, and Rabbi Yehudah the baker, Menachot 6b, end: Yasyin. Beitzah 8b: bar Yasinaya. Rif has Rabbi Yose bar Avin, a scribal error; Rosh has Rabbi Isi bar Yasin, also a scribal error. Kohelet Rabbah, on ‘Wisdom is good with an inheritance’: Rabbi Yose bar Yasin. But the same matter in Jerusalem Talmud, Berakhot, chapter 3, mishnah 4, has Rabbi Yose ben Yose. He is another, among the amoraim; see below. Bar Yasin, however, is a tanna of the baraita, for Menachot says: ‘It was taught: Rabbi Yose bar Yasin and Rabbi Yehudah the baker said.’ Avodah Zarah: ‘Rabbi Yose bar Yasyan raised an objection; he said.’ See above, Rabbi Yose bar Ashyan and Rabbi Yose ben Yose.
